g.text: J126 Sol 17-24 drive (playfield flashers) + tie-back cathodes of sol 21-24 on pins 10-13 (A-12697 D9-D12; N/C on STTNG)

g.desc: J126 Sol 17-24 drive (playfield flashers) + tie-back cathodes of sol 21-24 on pins 10-13 (A-12697 D9-D12; N/C on STTNG)

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: Flashlamp drivers (sol. 17-24): IRLR3110Z DPAK, latch U3 output HIGH = lamp ON, clocked by /SOL 2 (J113-9). Sol 17-20 keep an on-board S1M tie-back to +20V

g.desc: Flashlamp drivers (sol. 17-24): IRLR3110Z DPAK, latch U3 output HIGH = lamp ON, clocked by /SOL 2 (J113-9). Sol 17-20 keep an on-board S1M tie-back to +20V

g.text: (the A-12697 has none there); the sol 21-24 tie-back cathodes are brought out to J126-10..13 exactly like the A-12697 D9-D12, so the harness chooses the clamp rail.

g.desc: (the A-12697 has none there); the sol 21-24 tie-back cathodes are brought out to J126-10..13 exactly like the A-12697 D9-D12, so the harness chooses the clamp rail.

g.text: On STTNG sol. 17/18 drive the 12 V gun motors (motor high side on the +12V power rail of J118) through this group.

g.desc: On STTNG sol. 17/18 drive the 12 V gun motors (motor high side on the +12V power rail of J118) through this group.

g.text: Outputs on J126 (playfield, key pin 9) and J125 (backbox, key pin 4). Flasher supply +20V on J107-5/6 / J106-5.

g.desc: Outputs on J126 (playfield, key pin 9) and J125 (backbox, key pin 4). Flasher supply +20V on J107-5/6 / J106-5.
